Realme P3 5G (8GB + 128GB) is the best value at ₹16,999. It has the biggest battery and a sharp 120 Hz screen, but the weakest cameras of the three.

Phone	Price	Display	Camera	Battery
Realme P3 5G (8GB + 128GB)	₹16,999	6.67 in, 120 Hz	50 MP + 2 MP rear, 16 MP front	6000 mAh, 45W
Realme P2 Pro 5G	₹17,999	6.7 in, 120 Hz	50 MP + 8 MP rear, 32 MP front	5200 mAh, 80W
Alcatel V3 Ultra (8GB + 128GB)	₹18,410	6.78 in, 120 Hz	108 MP + 8 MP + 2 MP rear, 32 MP front	5010 mAh, 33W
Best camera: Alcatel V3 Ultra, with NFC too, but it costs the most and runs older Android 14.
Fastest charging: Realme P2 Pro 5G, with a stronger chip (Snapdragon 7s Gen 2) and a 32 MP selfie camera.

Prices are from Smartprix, updated Mon 26 Oct 2026, and may differ in shops. I only read the top of their list, so a cheaper option further down could exist.
